summary.building: Generic sequential paid mint stages with a cascading SeaDrop allowlist for the first Piggy Banks collection
summary.topRisk: SeaDrop does not pass leaf price, fee, or stage parameters to the NFT mint callback.
summary.mustDecideFirst: Finalize stage times and verify OpenSea's actual primary-drop fee before generating the Merkle root.
summary.watchOutFor: OpenSea documents a required final public sale, which conflicts with excluding balances below 10,000 $INJOH if presales do not sell out.

risks.title: Opaque callback parameters
risks.detail: The NFT callback cannot directly authenticate the allowlist leaf's price, fee, or stage.

risks.title: Lifetime wallet stats
risks.detail: Default lifetime accounting cannot enforce additive stage-local wallet limits.

risks.title: Cross-stage batch mint
risks.detail: A mint must not cross a configured cumulative stage boundary.

risks.title: Fee rounding
risks.detail: Expected net proceeds must match SeaDrop's floor-rounded fee calculation.

risks.title: Hosted public-stage conflict
risks.detail: The documented required final public sale conflicts with whitelist-only eligibility for unsold supply.

risks.title: Mutable external fee
risks.detail: The primary-drop fee must be verified immediately before root generation and publication.

risks.title: External publication state
risks.detail: Correct contracts do not automatically create or publish the hosted drop page.

risks.title: ERC-721 hook regression
risks.detail: Mint, transfer, and burn paths must retain the existing _update eligibility behavior.

risks.title: Reentrancy interaction
risks.detail: SeaDrop and safe-mint receiver callbacks require rollback tests.

risks.title: Wrong external deployment
risks.detail: The release must pin and verify SeaDrop runtime code on chain ID 4663.

risks.title: Reorganization
risks.detail: Release scripts must wait for confirmations and re-verify deployed code.

preCodingDecisions.title: Stage times and fee
preCodingDecisions.detail: Finalize the four time windows and observe the primary fee BPS before generating leaves.

preCodingDecisions.title: Whitelist-only hosting
preCodingDecisions.detail: Confirm OpenSea can omit or neutralize its documented final public stage, otherwise use a custom mint page.

requirementsCorrections.detail: Tier eligibility cascades downward rather than assigning one exclusive leaf per wallet.
SeaDrop lifetime wallet stats do not implement per-stage caps.
Allowlist leaves bind stage times, prices, fee BPS, and cumulative supply caps.
The documented hosted final public stage conflicts with a fully whitelist-only launch.

openQuestions: Can OpenSea publish this custom SeaDrop collection without an effective final public stage? Public documentation does not answer this.
